description: This PHP class represents a 'HomePage' entity for an ORM in a Human Resource Management system, mapping to the 'ohrm_home_page' database table with properties such as id, action, enableClass, priority, and userRole, and includes getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: HomePage
classes.description: Entity class mapping to 'ohrm_home_page' table, representing the homepage configuration with properties for id, action, enableClass, priority, and associated user role.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the homepage entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the homepage entity.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action associated with the homepage.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action associated with the homepage.

methods.name: getEnableClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class used to enable/disable the homepage element.

methods.name: setEnableClass
methods.description: Sets the CSS class used to enable/disable the homepage element.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the homepage element.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the homepage element.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the UserRole associated with this homepage configuration.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Sets the UserRole associated with this homepage configuration.
